entries.title: Fresh SQLite scaffold requires an undeclared auth-origin fix
entries.retirementCondition: The packed SQLite golden journey reaches login without an undocumented origin edit and its regression test passes.
entries.desiredBehavior: A packed SQLite scaffold reaches login using only creator-emitted configuration and instructions.

retirement.evidence: The authenticated packed SQLite auth-origin minimization reaches the login form at the documented default origin without an auth-origin environment edit.

entries.title: Dev server stays silent for at least 75 seconds after listen
entries.retirementCondition: The packed dev journey emits the required structured ready report within five seconds after socket bind.
entries.desiredBehavior: A packed scaffold prints its readiness URL and posture immediately after the server listens.

retirement.evidence: The authenticated packed strict-port dev probe completes initial app activation before exposing the listener, then emits the complete framework-owned readiness report inside the five-second post-bind contract.

entries.title: CLI help exits 1
entries.retirementCondition: Every packed help path writes usage to stdout and exits zero under the CLI exit-code contract suite.
entries.desiredBehavior: The packed kovo --help command exits 0, writes usage to stdout, and does not classify help as an error.

retirement.evidence: The authenticated packed @kovojs/cli help probe now exits zero with usage on stdout and no stderr.

entries.title: Bare check with no graph reports OK
entries.retirementCondition: A packed empty consumer fails closed without source graph or explicit artifact and the adversarial G7 suite passes.
entries.desiredBehavior: The packed kovo check command fails closed when an empty consumer has no source graph or explicit artifact.

retirement.evidence: The authenticated packed empty-consumer probe exits nonzero with the exact source-backed missing-app diagnostic and never reports a false OK.

entries.title: Failed build can leave a plausible graph under dist/.kovo
entries.retirementCondition: A deterministic failed packed build leaves the last good dist byte-identical and promotes no graph beneath dist/.kovo.
entries.desiredBehavior: A deliberately failed packed build never promotes its staged graph and leaves the last known-good dist untouched.

retirement.evidence: The authenticated packed transactional-build probe completes one good build, forces a deterministic KV417 failure, and proves the last-good dist digest is byte-identical with no failed graph promoted beneath dist/.kovo.

entries.title: Fresh-app check is coupled to KV417 trusted-boundary setup
entries.retirementCondition: Both freshly packed scaffold variants complete the quick source check without deployment-only KV417 setup while builds remain fail-closed.
entries.desiredBehavior: A newly packed scaffold completes check without bespoke KV417 classifier setup.

retirement.evidence: The strengthened authenticated packed probe scaffolds both Postgres/PGlite and SQLite variants and requires both full starter check scripts to pass without KV417.

entries.title: Full 44-component catalog check exceeds 2 GiB and times out or OOMs
entries.retirementCondition: The packed all-44-component fixture typechecks, checks, and builds with unimported copies under the provisional 2 GiB peak-RSS target until final runner ratification replaces it.
entries.desiredBehavior: A packed scaffold with all 44 copied components typechecks, checks, and builds under the provisional 2 GiB peak-RSS target.

retirement.evidence: The canonical three-sample authenticated packed run completed typecheck, check, and build with all 44 copied components left unimported; every process-tree peak remained below the provisional 2 GiB cap.

entries.title: Starter tests import an internal classifier mock
entries.retirementCondition: The packed starter test run uses only the public inferred artifact-scoped harness and contains no internal classifier mock.
entries.desiredBehavior: Packed starter tests use only the app-public inferred harness and no internal classifier import.

retirement.evidence: The authenticated create-kovo tarball contains the bootstrap-first public HTTP test journey and no internal classifier mock or test-setup shim.

entries.title: update-docs reports success after writing placeholder-only content
entries.retirementCondition: The packed offline update-docs command fails closed whenever version-matched substantive local documentation cannot be produced.
entries.desiredBehavior: Packed kovo update-docs fails when it cannot produce version-matched substantive local documentation.

retirement.evidence: The authenticated packed CLI installs at least 70 substantive version-matched local docs from its embedded snapshot with no placeholder corpus.

entries.title: Opaque trusted-boundary path returns an internal 500
entries.retirementCondition: The minimized packed request receives the intended safe diagnostic or response and never an unexplained internal 500.
entries.desiredBehavior: The packed scaffold handles the opaque trusted-boundary path without an unexplained internal 500.

retirement.evidence: The authenticated packed opaque-boundary probe reaches a healthy API and rendered login response instead of the former unexplained internal 500.
